statement: For every induced original packet, the stable S3 genus-three cover and all genus-two reflection quotients have full pro-2 fixed subgroup equal to selected cusp inertia.
depends_on: Olsson local logarithmic fiber calculation, Proposition 9.5 and Corollary 9.16
answers: Part A stable S3 first-cover full fixed subgroups at ell=2
Together with A.27 and A.30, closes every prime for these stable S3 covers
notes: New proof uses the crystalline global orbit span of a Delta-fixed logarithm in each semistable finite Lie quotient. Proves semistable representations with abelian image are crystalline, explicitly handles arbitrary cusp Kummer twists and logarithmic tangential fiber pullback over ramified local fields, and applies Fontaine N only on D_st. Parent independently audited the explicit logarithmic PD specialization, coefficient comparison, packet twisting and crystalline orbit-span proof, and integrated A.31 into the root paper/register.
